{"command": "cd ~/ctf_files && python3 -c "
from scapy.all import *
from collections import defaultdict
pkts = rdpcap('cap.pcap')
streams = defaultdict(list)
for p in pkts:
    if IP in p and TCP in p and p[TCP].payload:
        d = bytes(p[TCP].payload)
        if len(d)>10000: d=d[:10000]
        streams[(p[IP].src,p[TCP].sport,p[IP].dst,p[TCP].dport)].append(d)
resp = defaultdict(bytes)
req = defaultdict(bytes)
for k,v in streams.items():
    b = b''.join(v)
    if b.startswith(b'HTTP'):
        resp[k]=b
    else:
        req[k]=b
print('num requests', len(req), 'num responses', len(resp))
from collections import Counter
c=Counter()
for k,v in resp.items():
    # get body
    body = v.split(b'\r\n\r\n',1)[-1]
    c[body[:60]]+=1
for kk,vv in c.most_common(30):
    print(vv, kk)
"", "timeout": 120}
